disclaimer: Fashion-MNIST class match is not shopper relevance and does not validate real-world fashion recommendations. Images are 28x28 grayscale.

protocol.scoreDefinition: retrievalScore = sum(weight_s * cosine_s) / sum(weight_s) over query signals that are present. The signals are image and text. Each weight is 1. A missing query signal is omitted from the numerator and the denominator. It is not scored as zero. Cosine is the dot product of L2-normalized embeddings and lies in [-1, 1]. A candidate with no image embedding is omitted, not given a zero. If the query has neither an image nor a text embedding, retrieval fails and returns no list. Hard constraints run first and are not added into the score. If a requested constraint needs a field this catalogue does not contain, retrieval fails and does not invent that field. Diversity, when requested, keeps the top 50 candidates by retrieval score and reranks them with MMR(d) = 0.7 * retrievalScore(d) - 0.3 * max image-embedding cosine to an item already chosen. The redundancy term is 0 when nothing has been chosen yet. Lambda 1 keeps retrieval-score order, with id as the tie-break. The shopper attribute score is not applied here. Fashion-MNIST rows do not have price, stock, size, reviews, or comfort, and those values are not invented.

textLiteral.note: The literal template is shared by construction. It was not fit to the test split. Hybrid uses text only, so it should match clip-text.

pairedValidation.note: Validation pairs. Not used to select the hybrid weights.

diversityAblation.pool: top 50 by hybrid score, not the full index
diversityAblation.note: Compare diversity only with the relevance order of this same pool. Do not compare it with pixel or lexical search.
